definitions.explanation: Very close to completely. Used to indicate that something is almost at a certain state or level.
The greater part of something. Nearly all.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}はほとんど{終|お}わりました。
ほとんどの{人|ひと}が{来|き}ました。
ほとんど{食|た}べられませんでした。

notes: Can be written as {殆|ほとん}ど in kanji but hiragana is more common. With positive verbs: 'almost/mostly'. With negative verbs: 'hardly/barely'. ほとんどの + noun means 'most of the...'
